title: Game backgrounds
style: Children's picture book illustration made of cut paper, photographed flat: textured hand-cut paper shapes with soft drop shadows, gentle depth, warm glowing light, rich harmonious colors. A wide, open panoramic view that extends past every edge of the image, with calm, simple space in the left third; no arch, no cave, no surrounding frame. No text, no lettering, no border
editKeep: Keep everything else exactly the same: the same composition, camera, horizon, layers, colors and handcrafted cut-paper style.

layers.prompt: A wide, calm river Nile in warm golden afternoon light, seen from the near bank: smooth blue-green water with gentle ripples fills the lower two thirds of the picture, with a line of tall papyrus reeds and palm trees along the far bank and soft hills under a pale sky; no people, no boats, no baskets

Deep under the sea: soft blue-green water with sunbeams slanting down from the bright surface, gentle swaying seaweed and a few small fish near the sandy sea floor, a sunny sandy beach rising out of the water at the far right; no people, nothing else in the water

A sunny spring morning outside Jerusalem: a wide, smooth, pale dusty road runs straight across the lower part of the picture from the left edge all the way to the big open stone gate of the city at the right edge, with white stone city walls and towers above the gate, green hills and palm trees, and happy crowds of people waving palm branches standing along the far side of the road; the road itself is completely empty, no donkey, no Jesus, nothing on the road

The floor of a deep, rocky lions’ den at night, seen from inside, filling the whole picture edge to edge with no border, no frame and no paper margin: a wide, flat sandy floor fills the lower two thirds of the picture, rough cave walls of warm brown and grey stone rise behind it, and a soft beam of silver moonlight falls from a round opening high above; completely empty: no people, no lions, no animals of any kind

layers.edit: The den is now filled with warm, soft golden light glowing down from the opening above, as if an angel had just been there, with tiny golden sparkles floating in the air. Still empty: no people, no lions.

layers.prompt: A quiet, sunny town square in Jericho in warm golden afternoon light, filling the whole picture edge to edge with no border: pale stone paving across the lower half, a low stone well, a few palm trees and pale stone houses with arched doorways and striped awnings around the edges, soft blue sky; calm and simple, completely empty: no people, no animals

One single continuous scene that fills the whole picture from edge to edge, with no border, no blank paper and no fold: seen from a hill far away on a sunny day, a small round walled city of Jericho sits right in the middle of a huge, flat, open sandy plain, the city taking up only the middle third of the picture: a ring of tall, thick stone walls with little houses on top, palm trees inside; lots of wide, empty, flat sandy ground all around the city on every side, with hills along the far horizon; no people anywhere

layers.edit: Knock down the whole ring of city walls: the tall stone walls and their towers are completely gone, replaced by low, scattered heaps of broken stone blocks lying flat on the ground all the way around the city, with a pale, soft cloud of sandy dust drifting over them. The houses and palm trees inside the city stay exactly as they are. No fire, no smoke, no explosion, no people.

layers.prompt: One single continuous scene that fills the whole picture from edge to edge, with no border, no blank paper and no fold: a wide, soft green grassy hillside beside the Sea of Galilee in warm golden evening light: the lower two thirds of the picture is open green grass with little wildflowers, and far in the background a happy crowd of people sits resting on the hill, with the blue sea and little boats beyond; the foreground grass is empty

One single continuous scene that fills the whole picture from edge to edge, with no border, no blank paper and no fold: rocky hills at night under a deep blue sky full of stars and a crescent moon: big boulders, thorny bushes, little caves and tufts of grass spread across the whole lower two thirds of the picture, with soft moonlight; quiet and calm, not scary; no people, no animals

One single continuous scene that fills the whole picture from edge to edge, not a book, with no border, no page edges, no blank paper, no fold and no seam down the middle: a wide barley field near Bethlehem in warm golden morning light, the near part already harvested into short golden stubble across the lower two thirds of the picture, with tall standing barley and a few small reapers far in the back, rolling hills and the little hill town of Bethlehem on the horizon; no people in the foreground

A full-bleed painting: the scene itself reaches all four edges of the picture, one continuous view: the wide, flat rocky top of a high mountain above the clouds, glowing with soft warm golden light from above, a sea of fluffy clouds stretching out to the horizon all around, a few smooth boulders at the sides; calm, quiet and holy; no people

A full-bleed painting: the scene itself reaches all four edges of the picture, one continuous view: the wide, flat, rocky top of Mount Carmel in the late afternoon, with a big open patch of bare flat ground in the middle and a shallow ditch dug in a ring around it, a pile of firewood to one side, and crowds of tiny people watching from the rocks far behind, the sea glinting in the distance; nothing built in the middle yet
